id: title:Piccirello:measure img src against named posthog hosts

review.posthog_relevance: Updates Content Security Policy (CSP) report-only policies and version constants to replace wildcard hostnames with named hosts and update the report version from v=5 to v=7, improving the specificity and compatibility of CSP reporting for PostHog Cloud.
review.reason: The change updates CSP report-only policy implementation and documentation, replacing wildcard hostnames with named hosts and updating the report version constant. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and compatibility improvement for PostHog Cloud's security configuration.
review.uncertainty: While the code changes are clear, the actual operational benefit depends on the compatibility and security requirements of the specific CSP implementation, which is not fully demonstrated by the code alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No missing context prevents assessment.

observations.behavior: Documentation and implementation changes to CSP report-only policies, including removal of v=5 and addition of v=7, and replacement of wildcard with named hosts.
observations.code_quote: On PostHog Cloud, each app document also sends a report-only policy that holds only `img-src`, without `https:` and with each PostHog host named instead of `*.posthog.com`.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates documentation and implementation of CSP report-only policies to distinguish between the old v=5 policy and the new v=7 policy, which includes named PostHog hosts instead of wildcards.

observations.behavior: Updates report version constants and comments to reflect the removal of v=5 and addition of v=7.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the report version constant for the image shadow policy from v=5 to v=7, aligning with the documentation and implementation changes.

observations.behavior: Adds a new function to extract the bundle origin and uses it to populate named hosts in the CSP policy.
observations.code_quote: named_hosts = [source for source in (app_bundle_origin(), f"{POSTHOG_JS_CLOUD_HOST}/static/") if source]
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new function to extract the bundle origin and uses it to populate named hosts in the CSP policy, replacing the wildcard with named hosts.
